freezeRule: CTO Part 29 (via RULING-9): no new V1 capability enters casually. A new V1 capability requires: (1) dependency justification against the reconciled graph, (2) named ownership (one capability one owner), (3) security analysis against deny-by-default invariants, (4) impact analysis on the completeness loop, (5) evidence requirement definition (how it will be verified), (6) migration impact assessment, (7) verification plan, (8) an explicit recorded architectural decision (ADR). Scope changes after this lock are governance events, not engineering convenience.
